title: Preclinical Drug Testing in Scalable 3D Engineered Muscle Tissues
protocol: Dilute extracellular matrix (ECM) at a ratio of 1:100 in 8 mL of DMEM/F12 medium on ice.
Apply 8 mL of ECM solution to one T175 flask.
Incubate the flask with ECM solution at 37 °C for at least 1 h but no more than 24 h.
Aliquot 5 mL of skeletal muscle growth medium to a 15 mL conical tube.
Thaw a frozen vial of cells (5.0 x 10^5 myoblasts) in a water bath at 37 °C for 2 min until the ice is just melted.
Transfer the thawed cell vial into a biosafety cabinet (BSC).
Spray the vial with 70% ethanol.
Transfer cells from the vial to an aliquoted medium using a P1000 pipette without trituration.
Centrifuge the cells at 300 x g for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 1 mL of growth medium using a P1000 pipette.
Wash the ECM-coated flask with 15 mL of DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS from the flask.
Add 30 mL of growth medium to the flask.
Mix 4 mL of growth medium with the cell suspension.
Distribute the cell suspension into the T-175 flask, ensuring a total volume of 35 mL.
Slide the flask gently along the work surface left and right 5-6 times followed by forward and back 5-6 times to ensure even distribution of cells on the flask surface.
Place the T-175 flask in a cell culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Culture the cells for 3 days or until they reach no more than 70% confluency, then passage the cells.
Dilute ECM at a ratio of 1:100 in 30 mL of DMEM/F12 medium on ice.
Apply 10 mL of the diluted ECM solution to three T225 flasks.
Incubate the flasks at 37 °C for at least 1 h but no more than 24 h.
Wash cells with 15 mL of DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS and add dissociation reagent according to vendor's protocol.
Once cells are lifted, stop reaction according to vendor's protocol and collect cells into a conical tube.
Centrifuge the collected cells at 300 x g for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 1 mL of growth medium using a P1000 pipette.
Wash ECM-coated flask with 15 mL of DPBS.
Aspirate DPBS and add 40 mL of growth medium to each T225 flask.
Add 14 mL of the growth medium to cell suspension, mix thoroughly.
Distribute 5 mL of cell suspension evenly to each T225 flask.
Slide flasks gently along work surface left to right and forward to back to ensure even distribution.
Place flasks into cell culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Culture cells for 2-3 days or until confluency reaches no more than 70%, then passage.
Split cells at a ratio of 1:3 or 1:4, seed between 3 x 10^3 and 1 x 10^4 cells/cm².
Dilute the ECM at a ratio of 1:60 in 12 mL of DMEM/F12 medium on ice.
Apply 1 mL of the ECM solution to each well of two 6-well plates.
Incubate the plates at 37 °C for at least 1 h prior to cell seeding, but no more than 24 h.
Thaw a frozen vial of cardiomyocytes in a water bath at 37 °C for 2 min or until the ice is just melted.
Spray the vial with 70% ethanol and transfer it to the BSC.
Use a p1000 pipette to transfer the thawed cells into a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the empty cryovial with 1 mL of room temperature (RT) plating medium to recover any remaining cells.
Slowly dispense the 1 mL of rinse media dropwise (one drop every 5 s) into the conical tube of cells over the course of 90 s.
Continuously swirl the tube to mix the cells during the slow media addition.
Slowly add 8 mL of the plating medium using a 10 mL serological pipette to the 50 mL conical tube of cells.
Gently pipette up and down 3 times after all the media is dispensed to mix the cells thoroughly.
Count cells using a hemacytometer and trypan blue.
Centrifuge the cells in the 50 mL conical tube at 300 x g for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant after the cells have been pelleted.
Use a p1000 pipette to transfer 1 mL of the plating medium to the tube and gently break up the pellet by slowly pipetting up and down 3-5 times.
Resuspend the cells with an additional plating medium.
Seed between 2-4 x 10^6 cells per well of a 6 well plate in 2 mL of the plating medium.
Wash the ECM-coated 6-well plates with DPBS (2 mL/well).
Pipette 2 mL of cell suspension per well of a 6-well plate.
Move the plates gently along the work surface to the left and right 5-6 times followed by forward and back 5-6 times.
Place the plate into the cell culture incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Change to 3-5 mL of maintenance medium the next day after plating.
Change the medium every other day.
Culture cells for 3-4 days before casting into 3D tissues.
Apply 30 mL of the ECM solution to a T175 flask.
Incubate at 37 °C for at least 1 h prior to cell seeding, but no more than 24 h.
Aliquot 5 mL of the stromal cell medium into a 15 mL conical tube.
Thaw a frozen vial of stromal cells in a water bath at 37 °C for 2 min or until the ice has just melted.
Spray the vial with 70% ethanol and transfer it to the BSC.
Slowly add 1 mL of the stromal cell medium to the thawed cells in the vial using a p1000 pipette.
Transfer the cell suspension from the vial to the remaining thaw media in the conical tube.
Use a 5 mL serological pipette to mix the cells.
Pipette up and down 3 times.
Count the cells using a hemacytometer and trypan blue.
Wash the ECM-coated T175 flask with 15 mL of DPBS.
Transfer stromal cells to the flask at a density of 3-4 x 10^3 cells/cm².
Slide the flask gently along the work surface to the left and right 5-6 times followed by forward and back 5-6 times to ensure even distribution of cells on the flask surface.
Change media the next day with 45 mL of warmed stromal cell medium.
Culture the cells for 3-4 days before casting into 3D tissues.
Transfer 10 mL of PBS to a 100 mm cell culture dish and warm to 37 °C in a cell culture incubator.
Layer 0.5 g of fibrinogen powder over the entire surface of warm PBS and keep at 37 °C until fibrinogen has fully dissolved.
Sterile filter the reconstituted fibrinogen solution.
Run the dissolved fibrinogen solution through a 100 µm filter and collect it into a 50 mL conical tube.
Pour the filtered fibrinogen solution into a 10 mL syringe capped with a 0.2 µm filter.
Push the solution through the 0.2 µm filter and collect it into a new 50 mL conical tube.
Aliquot 300 μl of sterile fibrinogen into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes and store at -20°C.
Thaw aliquots on ice or at 4°C as needed, avoiding repeated freeze/thaws.
Add 6 ml of PBS and 4 ml of diH2O directly to one vial of thrombin (1 KU) to make a 100 U/ml thrombin stock solution.
Filter sterilize the thrombin solution with a 0.2 µm filter.
Aliquot the filtered thrombin solution into 1.5 mL plastic microcentrifuge tubes and store at -20°C, avoiding repeated freeze/thaws.
Measure 5 ml of 50% w/v PEI solution in a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 20 ml of diH2O to the PEI solution and mix thoroughly to yield a 10% stock solution.
To make a 0.1% PEI solution for cell culture, add 5 mL of 10% stock to 495 mL diH2O.
Sterile filter the 0.1% PEI solution using a 500 mL filter flask and store at RT for no longer than 1 week.
To make a 0.01% glutaraldehyde solution, add 40 µL of 25% stock to 99.6 mL diH2O.
Sterile filter the 0.01% glutaraldehyde solution and store at 4 °C for no longer than 1 week.
Place consumable tissue casting kit inside a sterile culture hood.
Fill the wells of a 24-well plate with 1.5 mL/well of a 0.1% PEI solution.
Submerge the tips of each pair of posts in the 24-well plate filled with PEI and let it sit for 10 min.
Fill the wells of a second 24-well plate with 2 mL/well of sterile diH2O.
Transfer the posts to the 24-well plate filled with water and let it sit for 1 min.
Fill the wells with 1.5 mL/well of 0.01% glutaraldehyde (GA).
Transfer the posts to the GA-filled wells.
Let the posts sit in GA for 30 min.
Aspirate the diH2O from the wells designated for rinsing.
Wash the wells with 2 mL/well of sterile diH2O.
Aspirate the wash solution.
Refill the wells with 2 mL/well of sterile diH2O.
Let the posts sit in fresh diH2O for 1 min.
Aspirate the diH2O from the wells.
Add another 2 mL/well of sterile diH2O to the wells.
Let the posts sit in this solution for 5 min.
Transfer the posts to a new 24-well plate.
Allow the posts to dry (approximately 15 min).
Reassemble the casting kit.
Parafilm the edges to seal the lid and the plate together.
Store at 4 °C for up to 72 h prior to cell seeding.
Pre-chill the tissue casting kit at 4 °C.
Prepare 50 µL of thrombin solution (3 µL of thrombin stock + 47 µL of EMT medium) per well to be cast on ice.
Place the chilled casting kit onto a cold block or ice inside the cell culture hood.
Lay the casting plate flat on ice.
Move the post lattice from the casting plate to a new, sterile 24-well plate.
Pipette 50 µL of thrombin solution into each pre-chilled well of the casting plate.
Reassemble the kit and return it to the refrigerator until needed for tissue casting.
Cast the tissues within 3 h of thrombin addition to the wells.
Prepare EMT base medium, sterile filter, and leave on ice.
Note: If cell-specific casting medium contains FBS, use heat-inactivated FBS as it may interact with fibrinogen and cause premature polymerization.
Prepare cardiac EMT medium by adding 500 mL of RPMI medium, 10 mL of B27, and 2.5 g of aminocaproic acid.
Optionally add 10 mM ROCK inhibitor to the EMT medium used for casting tissues (do not add it to the entire 500 mL volume).
Prepare skeletal EMT medium by adding 50 mL of F10 medium and 0.25 g of ACA for primary EMTs, and 0.1 g of ACA for iPSC-derived EMTs.
Warm the cell culture grade dissociation reagent to 37 °C.
Warm an equal volume of EMT medium to dilute the dissociation reagent.
Note: It is critical that the protease used is completely inactivated as active protease will interfere with 3D tissue formation and post adherence.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Use 2 mL/well for a 6-well plate.
Use 6 mL, 15 mL, and 15 mL for a 100 mm dish, T175 flask, and T225 flask, respectively.
Add the warmed cell culture grade dissociation reagent to lift the cells and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min or until the cells have lifted.
Transfer lifted cells to a 50 mL conical tube and triturate with a P1000 pipette to ensure a single-cell suspension.
Wash the plate or flask with EMT medium to collect remaining cells and add them to the conical tube.
Triturate the cells in the conical tube to ensure a single cell suspension.
Add EMT medium to terminate the dissociation process, and then take samples of the cell suspensions for cell counts.
Spin the cells at 200 x g for 4 min.
Perform cell counts using a hemacytometer and trypan blue while suspensions are centrifuged.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 5 mL of EMT base medium to remove residual dissociation reagent.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 x g for 4 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and prepare the cell suspensions at appropriate densities.
Increase the longevity and function of 3D skeletal muscle EMTs by adding 10%-20% ECM proteins in the EMT medium.
Seed stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (CMs) at 5 x 10^5 cells per tissue construct.
Seed stromal cells at 7.5 x 10^4 cells per tissue construct.
Resuspend stromal cells at a density of 2.5 x 10^6 cells/ml in EMT medium and keep on ice.
Use 30 µL of the resuspended stromal cell suspension per EMT.
Seed skeletal muscle myoblasts at 7.5 x 10^5 cells per tissue construct.
Resuspend skeletal muscle cells at a density of 8.3 x 10^6 cells/ml in EMT medium and keep on ice.
Use 90 µL of the resuspended skeletal muscle cell suspension per EMT.
Calculate volumes of each cell solution required for the desired number of tissues.
Pipette calculated volumes of cells into a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 10 µL of fibrinogen per EMT to the cell suspension and keep on ice.
Ensure each EMT contains 90 μl of cells, 10 μl of fibrinogen, and 50 μl of thrombin solution.
Transfer the tissue casting kit to a cell culture hood and remove the lid.
Keep the casting plate with post lattice laying flat on ice.
Mix the cell/fibrinogen mixture and draw up 100 µL with a P200 pipette.
Add 100 µL of the mixture to wells prepared with 50 µL of thrombin solution.
Triturate 5 times to mix well.
Hold both the lattice and casting well plate simultaneously using the pointer finger and thumb of one hand.
Repeat with a fresh P200 tip for each tissue until all tissues are cast.
Mix cell suspension in a 15 mL conical tube before casting each tissue.
Transfer the seeded kit to the incubator carefully.
Incubate at 37 °C for 80 min.
Prepare a fresh 24-well plate with 2 mL/well of EMT medium.
Warm the medium in the prepared plate at 37 °C.
Prepare 2 mL/well of growth medium containing 5 g/L aminocaproic acid for primary skeletal muscle tissues or 2 g/L ACA for iPSC-derived EMTs.
Incubate the plate with growth medium at 37 °C to warm the medium.
Add 1 mL of the EMT medium to the edge of the casting wells.
Incubate for another 10 min at 37 °C.
Carefully lift the post lattice and transfer the tissues from the casting plate to a prepared 24-well plate with medium.
Return the plates with tissues to the cell culture incubator at 37 °C.
Transfer the cast tissues to a fresh 24-well plate with 2 mL/well of EMT media and incubate at 37 °C for 24 hours.
Switch growth medium to differentiation medium for skeletal muscle cells to promote myoblast fusion after 24 hours.
Transfer cardiac tissues to fresh wells containing 2 mL/well of EMT medium every 2-3 days.
Transfer skeletal muscle tissues to fresh wells with 2 mL/well of differentiation medium containing 5 g/L Aminocaproic acid (0.2 mm sterile filtered) every 2-3 days.
Prepare a second 24-well plate with EMT medium and transfer the tissues to the fresh medium for medium changes, keeping the old medium plate alongside for subsequent use.
Alternatively, use a new plate for each medium change during culture period.
Measure EMT contraction via optical tracking of post deflection or magnetic sensing hardware.
